ValidationRule.description: This validation rule throws an error message if the start date is greater than end date
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT(CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'Digital Hub')), NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c < PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c, OR( ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeStartDate__c), ISCHANGED(PMC_SS_OutOfOfficeEndDate__c) ), NOT(ISNEW())
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Out Of Office Start Date cannot be after the Out of Office End Date
